reason: Conversation 1 initially misdiagnosed the screen behaviour as a 'software glitch or faulty display unit' and recommended an unjustified warranty repair and a reset, only correcting itself after the customer pushed back, and it also attributed the noise change to generic suction resistance rather than Auto mode's load/dust sensing, plus misnamed the head as the Laser Slim Fluffy and attached an irrelevant 'poor suction' image.
